card.title: PlayStation 5 No Image and No Sound

source.title: PlayStation 5 No Image and No Sound

symptoms: solid white light, no picture or sound

claims.statement: PS5 no image/sound: check the HDMI port (T-824 readings), the four chokes L3001–L3004 between encoder and port (8 lines, each needs continuity), and the MN864739 encoder.
The HDMI encoder circuit needs 5 V, 3.3 V, 1.8 V and 0.9 V present.

procedure: Check MN864739 for damage, shorts and its 5/3.3/1.8/0.9 V supplies.
Hot-swap port, replace chokes or encoder (preheat).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
